# Preload Hero

Source: [4401](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4401); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Preload Hero](../../api/actions/preload-hero.md).

<a id="wiki-4401-n1"></a>

- Preload uses players' skins and available memory; archive states capacity of 12 hero+skin combinations including those already used by players.

<a id="wiki-4401-n2"></a>

- Only one preload action is active per player: later executions overwrite earlier ones, so repeatedly preloading different heroes does not accumulate them.

<a id="wiki-4401-n3"></a>

- When supplying an array, earlier heroes get priority; slower storage is expected to benefit more.

Source limitations:

- 12-slot resource capacity and storage-performance guidance are archived and date-sensitive.
